messages:
alex: Heads-up — onboarding sample app triggered duplicate side-effects after a 429 on token refresh. quick log: 
```
14:00:01 app req=r1 -> 401
14:00:02 auth refresh -> 429
14:00:02 app retry -> webhook send r1
14:00:03 app retry -> webhook send r1
```

toni: ouch. are we doing jitter on refresh retries?

li: no, current backoff is linear 500ms * attempt. no jitter and no idempotency header on webhook. this combo causes amplification during refresh races.

alex: propose: add full jitter to auth refresh + middleware to add Idempotency-Key from payload.operation_id for outgoing webhooks. also add a quick e2e harness to assert at-most-once per op id under simulated 429.

toni: sounds good. prefer default jitter=strategy="full" for new sample app versions, but keep legacy behavior for old installs.

li: i'll implement jitter enum (none,fixed,full) and full jitter per AWS formula. will also emit metric samplekit.retry.refresh_count.

qa-bot: test idea: run race harness 1000x with auth 429 on first refresh and assert webhook receives <=1 call per operation_id.

alex: i'll add the middleware and the curl repro to the PR. small README note to recommend idempotency-by-default.

toni: assign and ship. post PR links here. close after QA runs green. :white_check_mark:
